final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.90.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

variable "rolename" {
  type        = string
  description = "The name of the IAM role for cross-account auditing access."
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote_arn" {
  type        = string
  description = "The AWS ARN of the remote principal allowed to assume this role."
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The external ID used to prevent confused deputy attacks during role assumption."
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AssumeRoleWithExternalId"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote_arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external_id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access_role" {
  name               = var.rolename
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json

  tags = {
    Name = var.rolename
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access_role.name

}

final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.5.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

variable "cloudhealth_aws_account_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The AWS Account ID of the CloudHealth platform allowed to assume the role."
  default     = "454464851268"
}

variable "cloudhealth_external_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The external ID assigned by CloudHealth to prevent confused deputy attacks."
  default     = "cloudhealth-external-id-example"
}

locals {
  name = "CloudHealth-IAM-Role"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_assume_role" {
  statement {
    sid     = "CloudHealthAssumeRoleWithExternalId"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = ["arn:aws:iam::${var.cloudhealth_aws_account_id}:root"]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.cloudhealth_external_id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "cloudhealth_role" {
  name                 = local.name
  description          = "Cross-account IAM role for CloudHealth cost and usage monitoring."
  assume_role_policy   = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_assume_role.json
  max_session_duration = 3600

  tags = {
    Name    = local.name
    Service = "CloudHealth"
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "cloudhealth_readonly_policy" {
  statement {
    sid    = "CloudHealthCostAndUsageAnalysisRead"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "autoscaling:Describe*",
      "aws-portal:View*",
      "ce:Get*",
      "cloudformation:Describe*",
      "cloudformation:Get*",
      "cloudformation:List*",
      "cloudfront:Get*",
      "cloudfront:List*",
      "cloudtrail:DescribeTrails",
      "cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus",
      "cloudwatch:Describe*",
      "cloudwatch:Get*",
      "cloudwatch:List*",
      "config:Describe*",
      "config:Get*",
      "dynamodb:Describe*",
      "dynamodb:List*",
      "ec2:Describe*",
      "ecs:Describe*",
      "ecs:List*",
      "elasticache:Describe*",
      "elasticbeanstalk:Describe*",
      "elasticfilesystem:Describe*",
      "elasticloadbalancing:Describe*",
      "elasticmapreduce:Describe*",
      "elasticmapreduce:List*",
      "iam:GenerateCredentialReport",
      "iam:Get*",
      "iam:List*",
      "kinesis:Describe*",
      "kinesis:List*",
      "kms:Describe*",
      "kms:Get*",
      "kms:List*",
      "lambda:Get*",
      "lambda:List*",
      "organizations:Describe*",
      "organizations:List*",
      "rds:Describe*",
      "rds:ListTagsForResource",
      "redshift:Describe*",
      "route53:Get*",
      "route53:List*",
      "s3:GetAccelerateConfiguration",
      "s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock",
      "s3:GetAnalyticsConfiguration",
      "s3:GetBucket*",
      "s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration",
      "s3:GetIntelligentTieringConfiguration",
      "s3:GetInventoryConfiguration",
      "s3:GetLifecycleConfiguration",
      "s3:GetMetricsConfiguration",
      "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
      "s3:ListAllMyBuckets",
      "s3:ListBucket",
      "sns:Get*",
      "sns:List*",
      "sqs:Get*",
      "sqs:List*",
      "tag:Get*",
      "workspaces:Describe*"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "cloudhealth_policy" {
  name        = local.name
  description = "Read-only inventory, configuration, and cost analysis policy for CloudHealth."
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.cloudhealth_readonly_policy.json

  tags = {
    Name    = local.name
    Service = "CloudHealth"
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "cloudhealth_attach" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_role.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_policy.arn
}

output "cloudhealth_role_arn" {
  description = "The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cross-account CloudHealth IAM role."
  value       = aws_iam_role.cloudhealth_role.arn
}

output "cloudhealth_policy_arn" {
  description = "The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the customer-managed CloudHealth IAM policy."
  value       = aws_iam_policy.cloudhealth_policy.arn
}
